Proof adaptation: `locallyPathConnectedSpace` proved by `(convex_stdSimplex ℝ ι).locallyPathConnectedSpace` instead of transport along the embedding homeomorphism

compatibility: The upstream Mathlib represents the topological standard simplex as `Convexity.StdSimplex ℝ ι` (finitely supported barycentric weights); the local Mathlib uses `stdSimplex ℝ ι`, the subtype of `ι → ℝ` of nonnegative coordinate vectors with sum one, which requires `[Fintype ι]` and carries the subtype sup metric. All statements mentioning the simplex were transcribed to `stdSimplex ℝ ι`; the coordinates `x.weights` correspond to `⇑x`. No other statement was changed.
scope: Ordinary singular homology toolkit: rational Mayer–Vietoris long exact sequence for an open cover of a space and for two open subsets (`RationalHomologyMayerVietoris`, `OpenRational`), integral homology of the circle and of standard spheres (`SmallCircleHomology`, `SphereHomologyInduction`), homology of a point and of contractible spaces (`Point`, `ContractibleModel`), and the ℤ-to-ℚ coefficient comparison (`RationalScalarExtension`, `RationalSingularChains`), with their dependencies (barycentric subdivision, small chains, singular cochain formulas).
